scope.host: Apple M1 macOS; fresh process per case
scope.session_settings: CPU, batch 1, requested intra/inter threads 1, spin false, graph Level3
scope.memory_metrics: ps RSS and time-l maximum RSS; vmmap physical footprint/peak plus reusable and swapped-out accounting

interpretation_limits: Do not compare RSS directly with physical footprint.
Swapped-out is vmmap accounting, not a separate measured disk-swap I/O total.
MALLOC_LARGE_REUSABLE residency is not live model-weight ownership.
The legacy and default-current physical results are single observations under different reclamation states; no precise memory-saving percentage is established.
Fixed-shape/shared-pool/allocator flags are diagnostics only and are not production changes.
No live-memory leak is established; post-drop physical footprint is recorded separately from retained RSS.
